summary: The root كره (krh) signifies dislike, displeasure, or disapproval. It is the opposite of desire, contentment, or love.
lane: 1 كَرِهَهُ ذ [ He disliked, was displeased with, disapproved of, hated, him or it. ] الكَرَاهَةُ is the contr. of الإِرَادَةُ and الرِّضَى . (Marg. note in TA.) -b2- كَرِهَهُ (Mgh, Msb), inf. n. كَرَاهَةٌ and كَرَاهِيَةٌ , (Mgh,) or كُرْهٌ and كَرْهٌ , (Msb,) He did not desire it; he disapproved it, or was displeased or discontented with it; (Mgh;) he disliked it; disapproved it; hated it; contr. of حَبَّهُ . (Msb.) -b3- كَرِهَ and : see سَخِطَ .

headwords.def: تَكَرَّهَهُ He showed, or expressed, dislike, disapprobation, or hatred, of it; see تَاَجَّمَهُ and تَسَخَّطَهُ : and عَليْهِ signifies the same; see قَنَحَ . تَكَرَّهَ He expressed dislike, displeasure, disapprobation, discontent, or hatred. (IbrD.) See examples in the K, voce أَخّْ , and voce أَفّْ , &c. The above is the prevailing signification, and often occurs. تَكَرَّهَهُ i. q. كَرِهَهُ , q. v. (K, * TA.) See also تَأَجَّمَهُ .

headwords.gloss: Disliked, disapproved of, blamed; hated; hateful, blameable, displeasing; odious
headwords.def: كَرِيهٌ Disliked, disapproved of, blamed, or hated; hateful, blameable, displeasing, or odious; as also .
الكَراَهِيَةُ للشَّىْءِ signifies البُغْضُ لَهُ and عَدَمَ مُلَاءَمَتِهِ . (MF in art. ابى .)
كَارِهٌ Unwilling: see an ex. voce أَسَآءَ .

headwords.gloss: A thing that one dislikes, disapproves; hates; that one dislikes to do

parts.t: A thing that one dislikes, disapproves,
an event, that is an object of dislike

headwords.def: مَكْرَهٌ A thing that one dislikes, disapproves, or hates, or that one dislikes to do: opposed to مَنْشَطٌ : (TA in art. نشط :) [ a thing, or an event, that is an object of dislike or hatred ].

headwords.gloss: Foul, abominable; evil; i. q; held in aversion
headwords.def: مَكْرُوهٌ Foul, abominable, or evil; i. q. سَيِّئٌ ; (Beyd, xvii. 40;) and شَرٌّ : (TA:) [ held in aversion ]. See كَرِيهٌ . مَكَارِهُ , a pl. of مَكْرُوهٌ . مَكَارِهُ الدَّهْرِ The afflictions, or calamities, of fortune; syn. نَوَازِلُهُ and شَدَائِدُهُ . (TA.) See also مَكْرَهٌ .
مُسْتَكْرَهٌ : see an ex. voce عَرَضٌ .
